comparison.deployment_note: Composite experimental recipes need exact-pipeline CPU and business-integration verification; ordinary single-weight manifests cannot activate them.

cpu_protocol.pipeline: ImageStore.prepare -> normalized PNG RGB decode -> exact experiment recipe -> selected global confidence filter
cpu_protocol.cache_policy: Retain warmed model/predictor only; every call re-reads raw JPEG outside timing and freshly prepares/decodes/views/predicts. Saved results are retained only for untimed parity diagnostics, never reused as inference inputs.
cpu_protocol.parity: CPU normalized upload pixels versus existing GPU validation export; require pixel hashes to verify raw RGB equals normalized RGB. Stable class/IoU>=.99 and confidence tolerance .0001 paired diagnostic plus IoU>=.5 operational pairing. Any exact numerical/detection difference is reported.

cpu_run_policy: Use isolated-v2. Earlier v1 overlapped the external CPU check and is retained but excluded from accepted timings.

limitations: Qualitative selected six-photo exploration, not expert ground truth or accuracy.
Recipes use separately selected thresholds .25 and .3; visual differences cannot all be attributed to flipping.
No retuning on these photos; no backend integration or automatic task creation.
